messages:
jess_cs: Morning team — Candescent Labs signed overnight. I want a compact activation run so we can validate SSO, confirm data residency, and hit an initial traffic milestone for product sign-off. Who can own PM/Eng/renewal tracking?

leah_pm: I can take PM. I'll own stakeholder comms and the kickoff slide deck. Planning to align scope: SSO (SAML), export controls, and a small prompt library.

tom_eng: Eng here. I'll take SSO + prod smoke tests. Will provision a debug API key and open a short runbook for Candescent infra. ETA for debug key: 6 hours.

rachel_cand: Thanks — I'm Priya's backup (Rachel) at Candescent. Quick notes from the customer: they need audit logs enabled and a one-pager about latency guarantees. Prefer an enablement slot Thurs morning ET.

maya_success: I'll do renewal/risk. Proposed acceptance criteria: SSO working end-to-end, audit logs streaming, and >=200 successful inference calls within 14 days. If not met, auto-escalate to AM.

jess_cs: Solid. Minimal T+48 plan (drop into their workspace):
```
T+0: Intro call scheduled (leah_pm)
T+4h: eng access + debug key (tom_eng)
T+12h: SSO handshake test with Candescent IdP (tom_eng + rachel_cand)
T+24h: audit-logs integration validated (maria_ops)
T+48h: run 50 end-to-end requests + basic quality check (jess_cs)
Feedback: short form after T+48h (maya_success)
```
(we'll adapt if Thurs enablement is earlier)

jess_cs: Links: onboarding playbook https://redwood.internal/onboards/candescent, SLOs + latency doc https://redwood.internal/docs/slo-latency.

devops-bot: Created ticket CS-1199 "Candescent 48h activation" assigned to tom_eng, leah_pm, jess_cs. https://tickets.redwood/CS-1199

tom_eng: Need the IdP metadata file. @rachel_cand can you drop SAML metadata or a contact? Also, what's the preferred encryption at rest note they need?

rachel_cand: Dropped contact: priya@candescent.io and pasted SAML metadata in a DM. They require AES-256 at rest and monthly audit exports.

leah_pm: I'll schedule the Thurs enablement for 9am ET and include: agenda (1) goals, (2) SSO flow, (3) audit logs, (4) first-run checklist. I'll attach a one-pager on latency guarantees.

maya_success: Drafting a 4-question feedback pulse: integration ease, latency perceived, prompt quality, renewal intent (Y/N + why). Will post to drive and link in CS-1199.

jess_cs: Action owners summary: leah -> invite + deck + one-pager; tom -> debug key, SSO test; maya -> feedback form + risk rule; rachel -> Priya contact + IdP metadata; i'll run the first 50 requests and note issues in the onboarding doc. Keep CS-1199 updated. :pray:

leah_pm: Invite sent to Priya + team for Thu 9am ET.

tom_eng: Debug key done and placed in the secure folder. Starting SSO test now.

maya_success: Feedback form uploaded: https://drive.redwood/onboards/candescent/feedback.md

jess_cs: Great progress. We'll reconvene here after the 48h check and mark status (green/yellow/red). Thanks all! :sparkles:
